research_object: Habitat-resolved abundance, composition, activity, and geochemical significance of the marine deep biosphere.
must_preserve: Separate aphotic water, sediment/pore water, and upper oceanic crust.
Separate volume, standing abundance, functional potential, and realized activity/flux.
Treat deep-biosphere astrobiology as an Earth-analogue inference, not an extraterrestrial detection.
seed_direction: Construct a hierarchical DeepBio Census that fuses habitat geometry, calibrated cell counts, multiomics, geochemistry, and rate constraints into compartment-specific uncertainty distributions.
